description: Read your career preferences, saved facts, completeness, plan, remaining usage, latest 20 resumes and the connected client send grant. Use before suggesting profile edits or paid actions. Unconfirmed facts are suggestions, not permission or truth. Never modifies anything.
name: get_profile

citizenships.description: Null when nothing is known. Change it with update_profile citizenships.

codes.description: ISO alpha-2 codes, primary first; empty for a stateless member.

confirmed.description: False while the list is assumed from the resume or an earlier answer.

countries_without_sponsor.description: ISO alpha-2 codes where the member can work without a sponsor, read from the citizenships, the work statuses and the residence.

confirmed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; null for an unconfirmed suggestion.

mined_value.description: The most recent AI suggestion; may differ from value on a confirmed fact awaiting re-review.

params.description: Canonical parameters scoping a parameterized answer (e.g. {"country":"uk"}); empty object for a plain fact.

source.description: user = typed/confirmed by the person; mined = AI suggestion; answer = promoted from a screening answer they gave; memory = AI suggestion drawn from their chat with the NeverApply assistant.

entitlements.description: Entitlement feature keys from config/entitlements.php the user currently holds.

limits.description: Daily caps relevant to plan/usage decisions.

mcp_reads_remaining.description: Remaining read calls today for this member and OAuth client.

plan_tier.description: Human-readable plan label, e.g. "Free", "Lifetime", "Complimentary", or the subscribed plan name.

prefer_stated_intent.description: True when matching weights the stated roles over the resume history (the rehomed D12 intent question).

worldwide.description: True when the user has explicitly opted into no geographic filter.

residence.description: Where the member lives, as one record. Null when no country is known. Change it with update_profile residence_*.

confirmed.description: False while the residence is assumed from an earlier answer.

listing.description: Present only for a tailored variant linked to a listing.

quality_score.description: The book-grounded quality score total when scored, falling back to the legacy ATS score; null when neither is stored.

work_statuses.description: Null when nothing is known. A country with no status and no citizenship needs a sponsor, except the country the member lives in, which waits. Change it with update_profile work_statuses.

confirmed.description: False while the list is assumed from the resume or an earlier answer.

statuses.description: ISO alpha-2 code to work status: permanent_resident, open_permit, open_permit_that_ends, employer_tied or needs_sponsor. Only countries no citizenship covers.

title: Get your profile
